taskVersion.name: ves-real-item

parts.text:
You are a hydrogeologist preparing site notes for a borehole drilling team.

Station Opiro (Etche LGA survey stations). Interpreted VES layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 54.639 | 0.2147 | 0.2147
2 | 9147.8 | 0.30305 | 0.51774
3 | 1119.9 | 21.107 | 21.625
4 | 2566.8 | - | -

Write the site note using exactly this template:

Station: <station name>
Curve type: <VES curve type>
Aquifer depth: <depth range in m>
Recommendation: <one or two sentences for the drilling team>

Station: Opiro
Curve type: KH
Aquifer depth: 0.52 m – 21.63 m
Recommendation: The relatively low-resistivity zone (layer 3, ~1120 Ω·m) sandwiched between two higher-resistivity units indicates the main water-bearing horizon; drill and screen between approximately 0.5 m and 21.6 m depth, with casing set through the thin surface layers to prevent collapse, and terminate drilling once the underlying resistive layer 4 (basement/compact formation) is encountered.
